name: select_diagnose_failure
prompt: My "Phishing Triage" playbook failed on its last run. Why?

forbidden_facts.label: pulled run env instead of diagnosing

notes: why_did_playbook_fail is the orchestrator that chains list_recent_failed_runs -> get_run_env -> diagnose_yaml_against_pb_execution. Its individual links are all separately advertised in the build slice, which is exactly the decoy shape that broke the run path -- so this fixture measures whether the model picks the one-call answer or hand-rolls the chain. Hand-rolling still reaches an answer, so the decoys stay informational; only never diagnosing fails the gate.
